title: Last wishes: Japan, his clothing, no hasty decisions
summary: He wanted to tour again and return to Japan, and asked that his belongings not be dealt with too hastily. Recording interruptions.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing the interview: thanks, goodbyes and tape running out

blocks.x: And, uh, he's, he's, he's, he's mainly spoke of Japan. He also spoke of what we should do with his, uh, clothing if he did pass away. We shouldn't rush into anything too, too quickly. He said it would be a while before we would adjust to his absence. And, uh, to be sure. Good evening.
We just weren't too hasty. And since then, we haven't been. We just had things as they are.
